hook_text: Nobody left a letter. So how do we know how they lived?
clip_script: Mossel Bay, a museum display. Tiny shell beads with holes, more than seventy thousand years old, from Blombos Cave. A notebook of San stories, written down in Cape Town in the 1870s. A rock painting of running hunters with bows. And old books by European travellers, which we must read carefully, because they may be biased. Stories, objects, rock paintings and books: four kinds of sources. Put them together, and the past begins to speak.
visual_style: Whiteboard museum case with four objects lighting up in turn: beads, notebook, painting, book.
mood: Mysterious and clever, like detectives solving a case.
pacing: One source per beat, then all four come together at the end.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and sort five sources into the four kinds.
